name: deus_discover
description: Search Deus service listings (plain-language + filters). Read-only.

name: deus_get_service
description: Get a Deus service listing by id. Read-only.

name: deus_quote
description: Get a signed EIP-712 price quote for a service operation. Read-only.

name: deus_invoke
description: Invoke a Deus service (proxy or hosted). Payments ride LXP on LayerX: a priced call answers 402 with USDX terms, the bridge auto-signs and retries under the owner leash (LAYERX_MAX_SPEND_USDX per call, LAYERX_MAX_DAILY_USDX rolling daily) and returns the result with the LayerX receipt (layerx_receipt.seq); over-leash or unleashed terms are surfaced without signing. WRITE: spends USDX from the agent DID's LayerX account.

name: deus_invocation_status
description: Get invocation status and receipt metadata. Read-only.

name: deus_my_spend
description: Get this authenticated agent DID's Deus spend totals grouped by service. Read-only.
